info.title: API.SH: CNBC
info.description: The CNBC API from API.SH: public CNBC data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One full CNBC article: headline, description, authors, published and updated times, section, keywords, key points, headings and body paragraphs in order, images, video, word count and the tickers listed in the article. Give an article link in `url`, or `latest=true` (with an optional `section`) to get the newest story of a section.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-article

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true` to return the newest article of `section` instead of giving `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Price bars (time, open, high, low, close, volume) of a CNBC symbol for a range: intraday for 1D and 5D, daily or weekly for longer ranges.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-chart

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
CNBC's market boards for a region: every index, future, currency, commodity, bond yield or crypto on the board with its full quote (price, change, change %, open, high, low, previous close, 52-week range, volume, extended-hours quote and more), plus the market movers of an index or region: top gainers and losers by % change, or the most active by volume or by volume against the 10-day average. Each mover: rank, symbol, name, link, price, change, change %, previous close, volume, 10-day average volume, P/E, dividend yield, implied volatility, pre-market and after-hours change, 52-week high/low flags and last trade time.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-markets

parameters.name: movers
parameters.description: Movers of this index or region (default sp500 for us, europe and asia for those regions, otherwise none).

parameters.name: rank
parameters.description: change (gainers and losers, default), volume (most active) or relative_volume (volume against the 10-day average).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The latest CNBC headlines in a section (about 30, newest first): title, summary, link, type and publish time. Headlines and summaries only, not full articles. `q` keeps headlines containing a word.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-news

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only headlines whose title or summary contains this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Quotes from CNBC for up to 50 symbols (stocks, indices, currencies, commodities, bonds): name, type, exchange, currency, market status, price, change, open, high, low, previous close, volume and 10-day average, 52-week high/low with dates, market cap, shares outstanding, P/E and forward P/E, EPS, dividend and yield, beta, revenue, margins, ROE, EBITDA, debt/equity, bond yield, the pre/after-hours quote, next earnings date and ex-dividend date. Unknown symbols are listed in `not_found`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-quote

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated CNBC symbols: tickers (AAPL), indices (.SPX, .DJI, .IXIC), currencies (EUR=, JPY=), commodities (@CL.1, @GC.1), Treasury yields (US10Y).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Symbols matching a prefix of a ticker or company name, as CNBC's quote search suggests them: symbol, name, type (stock, ETF, fund, index...), exchange and country. Use the symbol with /cnbc/v1/quote.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/cnbc-symbols-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: q

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
